get.summary: Gets the authenticated user's guild registration and membership state.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes the caller's guild registration and roster from Planner.
delete.description: Requires the caller to be a linked Leader or Co-Leader of a registered guild. Deletes the guild and all of its member rows from Planner. This does not affect the guild in Tacticus itself, only Planner's registration of it, and cannot be undone — any current member can re-register it afterward.

get.summary: Gets the caller's guild's current Guild Raid status.

401.description: Unauthorized

404.description: The authenticated profile has not been provisioned.

post.summary: Forces a Guild Raid status refresh for the caller's guild.
post.description: Performs an upstream Guild Raid sync subject to a one-minute per-guild cooldown measured from the last attempt, successful or failed; a request inside the cooldown returns the current persisted result instead of calling upstream.

200.description: Current Guild Raid status after refresh.

401.description: Unauthorized

404.description: The authenticated profile has not been provisioned.

post.summary: Re-synchronizes the authenticated user's guild from the Tacticus API.
post.description: Fetches fresh guild data using the stored Guild API token and requires the caller to still appear as Leader or Co-Leader in that fresh response before any data changes. The stored token itself is never replaced by this endpoint.

400.description: The upstream guild response was malformed.

401.description: The request is missing required identity claims.

403.description: No linked/registered guild, no stored token, or the caller is no longer Leader/Co-Leader.

409.description: A database uniqueness conflict with an existing guild or membership.

503.description: The Tacticus API is currently unavailable.

post.summary: Registers a Tacticus guild using a Guild-scoped API token.
post.description: Requires the caller to have a configured Tacticus User ID and to appear as the guild's Leader or Co-Leader in the upstream response. Performs a complete synchronization and persists the encrypted token. Re-registering an already-registered guild updates it rather than duplicating it.

400.description: Blank/invalid token, malformed upstream guild response, or no Tacticus User ID configured.

401.description: The request is missing required identity claims.

403.description: The caller is absent from the guild or below Co-Leader.

404.description: The authenticated account/profile has not been provisioned.

409.description: A database uniqueness conflict with an existing guild or membership.

503.description: The Tacticus API is currently unavailable.

delete.summary: Permanently deletes the authenticated user's planner account and all related data.

Also makes a best-effort attempt to delete the corresponding Microsoft Entra External ID identity; see IExternalIdentityDeleter for the current limitation.
